peer_identity.arc_label: Othon von Salza — pirate heir through castrated Metabaronic founder
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Merge: pure id-format duplicate. The 9-record merged card is the authoritative identity. Discard othon_von_salza.
peer_identity.rationale: Two peer_card_ids for the same character, differing only in id format (hyphen vs underscore). Both share the alias 'othon von salza'. No phase or role split indicated. othon-von-salza is the 9-record merged card spanning vol01–10; othon_von_salza appears to be a duplicate staging artifact. Canonical: hyphen format (cleaner, consistent with other merged cards).
